info.name: App Marketplace accounting-entries Export API (v1) API

items.docs:
The Export Job Events imply the different status of an Export Job through the export lifecycle.
            Use this endpoint to create a new status.
            For example, started event implies the export job is initiated.
            The existing Export Job Events are as follows:
            - started: An export job is initiated. This allows the integration
                service to start processing the export job items.

info.name: Get a list of Export Jobs

params.name: company_id
params.description: Enter the specific company ID for which you want to retrieve the list of export jobs processed before.

params.name: status
params.description: Fetch a list of jobs for a specific status.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Fetch a list of jobs for specific statuses.

params.name: before
params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset]).

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset]).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after]).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return.

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by.

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.
